title: Beaten at Carthago and in the field near Hadrumetum, the army is offered the crossing home from the shore, with the days it waits for ships
At sea for Roma, the panel names the march on to Capua that follows
Landed at Roma, the army marches on to Capua
Idle 15 km from Mediolanum at war, the panel says why it does not besiege and offers Besiege
A Roman army beaten overseas sails home from the shore, a crossing for Capua lands at Roma and marches on, and an army beside an enemy city offers Besiege
